blind_target.authors: De Fruyt, Van De Wiele, & Van Heeringen
blind_target.evidence_quote: De Fruyt and colleagues (2000) investigated the relation between Cloninger’s Temperament and Character Dimensions (Cloninger, 1987) and the Big Five personality index. The researchers found that Cloninger-assessed persistence correlated with the Big Five trait conscientiousness, r(128) = .46, p < .001, d = 1.04, 95% CI = [.64, 1.43].
blind_target.outcome_quote: Across all replication studies (N = 3,193), there was little evidence for a relationship between conscientiousness measured with the TIPI and persistence measured with the unsolvable anagram task, r(3191) = .027, p = .134, 95% CI = [-0.008, 0.061], d = .05, 95% CI = [-.02, .12].
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: No De Fruyt entry appears in the supplied reference list; author names and year are supplied by the effect heading, title and DOI unavailable. Behavioral conceptual replication has no reliable predicted correlation.

blind_target.title: Moral credentials and the expression of prejudice.
blind_target.evidence_quote: Monin and Miller (2001) tested whether participants were more willing to express prejudicial attitudes when their prior behavior provided evidence that they were non-prejudiced.
blind_target.outcome_quote: In sum, the replications showed a similar main effect of the predicted credentials manipulation on making sexist judgments, but did not replicate the unexpected moderation by gender.14

shipped_originals.title_o: A controlled experiment in maintenance: comparing design patterns to simpler solutions

blind_target.evidence_quote: An article published in 2001 reported a controlled experiment that compared maintenance of small programs using design patterns with maintenance of equivalent programs using simplified design solutions. A replication of that experiment was published in 2004. In 2010, a group of researchers from multiple countries picked this experiment as the subject of an attempt to perform a joint replication: Many groups performing an experiment using the same setup, each contributing a few data points to a larger overall data set. This article reports on one of those sub-replications.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Only one of the results is statistically significant; it confirms the result of the original experiment stating that the simplified version of the GR program could be extended more quickly than the pattern version which used the Abstract Factory and Composite patterns.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The only explicit original-result comparison in the available abstract confirms the original. Other nonsignificant results are not explicitly compared, so the broader outcome remains uncertain.
